reason: I already announce my sales free on WhatsApp broadcast and Instagram stories, and I'm not convinced my customers read SMS offers instead of swiping them away as spam. LKR 560 is small, but my accountant asks me to justify every new cost, and 0.56 per SMS is not obviously cheaper than what other providers quote, so I'd rather line up three rates first than pay for this.
objection: Do people even read SMS offers, or do they treat them as spam when I can reach them on WhatsApp for free?
would_change_my_mind: Proof from a similar Sri Lankan online seller that an SMS blast brought real orders, or a clear rate at or below LKR 0.45 per SMS on the 1,000 pack so it wins my three-way comparison.
